== Notes ==
* Ancestor's Visage coupled with [[Famine]] (and, to a lesser extent, [[Mind Wrack]]) is extremely powerful when used on a single [[tank]] who is absorbing damage. It is one of the combinations that becomes more and more powerful as the number of enemies (particularly melee enemies) increases.
* Can be effectively used as a [[prot]] against adrenaline-using builds, hampering their ability to [[pressure]]/[[spike]] effectively.
